plain: Filippo Biondi, a scientist who says he scanned beneath the pyramids of Giza in Egypt, tells of shafts blocked with debris between the Khafre pyramid, one of the great pyramids there, and the Sphinx. According to his team's scans, he says, they are very confident these shafts connect to underground facilities lying below Giza, which would mean a hidden built world under the famous monuments.
